root_cause: Flow Slate accepted a virtual clipboard paste visually but persisted only the first physically typed character to the server generation card.
retry_rule: Do not resubmit until the current candidate is terminal, the three-job ten-minute generation rest is complete, and at least fifteen minutes have elapsed from the failed submission. Re-enter the whole prompt with pressSequentially-style real keystrokes, then verify the post-click server card before accepting the retry.
